concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-custom-payouts-scheduled-payouts-view-custom-payout-executions]] — 2026-09-15 Configuration API/Customer Area guide for custom-schedule execution records, success-to-transfer ID, skip/failure reasons and disabling; execution is not bank receipt.
warnings: A succeeded execution initiates a transfer; follow Transfer webhooks for later states, and do not equate Sent/booked with beneficiary bank receipt.
A final failure can disable the sweep; root cause must be resolved before expecting future executions.
API response sample uses sweepDisabled string where failed webhook uses sweepConfigurationDisabled boolean; blocked-counterparty reason codes also differ across examples.
